title: Review executive KPI overview
description: Verifies that opening the dashboard shows the core executive KPI summary needed for quick survey health review.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the executive KPI cards are displayed
Verify the NPS and CSAT summary values are displayed

title: Review executive KPI summary
description: A user can open the dashboard and see the core executive KPI summary for NPS, CSAT, and response breakdown counts.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify NPS, CSAT, and response breakdown KPI cards are displayed

title: Filter the dashboard by faculty career and cycle
description: A user can apply the full faculty to career to cycle cascade and see the dashboard reflect the final filtered scope.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty filter value
Select a career filter value
Select a cycle filter value
Verify the dashboard updates to the selected faculty, career, and cycle scope

title: Filter the dashboard by faculty
description: A user can narrow the executive dashboard to a faculty and see the dashboard update to that scope.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty filter value
Verify the dashboard updates to the selected faculty scope

title: Inspect NPS distribution details
description: Verifies that the NPS distribution can be inspected from the executive dashboard and its breakdown is visible on interaction.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Hover over the NPS distribution visualization
Verify the NPS distribution details are displayed

title: Inspect CSAT distribution details
description: Verifies that the CSAT distribution can be inspected from the executive dashboard and its breakdown is visible on interaction.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Hover over the CSAT distribution visualization
Verify the CSAT distribution details are displayed

title: Reset dashboard filters to all data
description: Verifies that resetting the filters returns the dashboard to the full unfiltered dataset.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty from the faculty filter
Select a career from the career filter
Select the filter reset control
Verify all dashboard data is displayed again

title: Reset global dashboard filters
description: A user can reset the global filters and return the dashboard to the full data view.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty filter value
Select a career filter value
Reset the dashboard filters
Verify the dashboard returns to the unfiltered overview

title: Switch radar chart categories
description: Verifies that changing the radar chart category multiselect updates the operational view to the chosen categories.

steps.description: Navigate to /#operativo
Select categories in the radar chart multiselect
Verify the radar chart updates to the selected categories

title: Inspect radar chart dimension tooltip
description: Verifies that hovering a radar chart dimension reveals its satisfaction breakdown for operational comparison.

steps.description: Navigate to /#operativo
Hover over a radar chart dimension label or data point
Verify the satisfaction breakdown tooltip is displayed

title: Review detailed satisfaction metrics table
description: Verifies that the detailed view shows the satisfaction table with the key summary metrics used for analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /#detallado
Verify the detailed satisfaction table is displayed
Verify the T2B, T3B, and weighted average metrics are displayed

title: Inspect detailed distribution bar breakdown
description: Verifies that hovering a distribution bar in the detailed table reveals the per-level breakdown for that metric.

steps.description: Navigate to /#detallado
Hover over a distribution bar in the detailed table
Verify the per-level distribution details are displayed

title: Review sentiment and comment analysis overview
description: Verifies that the qualitative view shows the sentiment summary, category summary, and comment exploration entry points needed for text analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Verify the sentiment distribution is displayed
Verify the comment analysis sections are displayed

title: Search comments by keyword
description: Verifies that searching comments by a keyword narrows the qualitative results to matching comments.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Fill a keyword into the comment search field
Verify the comments list is filtered to matching results

title: View sentiment summary on the qualitative dashboard
description: This verifies that a user can open the qualitative dashboard and review the sentiment summary charts and lists expected for analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Verify sentiment distribution is displayed
Verify positive and negative aspect lists are displayed

title: Filter qualitative comments by sentiment and category
description: Verifies that applying sentiment and category filters narrows the qualitative comments to the expected subset.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Select a sentiment filter
Select a category filter
Verify the comments list reflects the selected sentiment and category filters

title: Inspect NPS segment bars in the qualitative view
description: This verifies that a user can review the promoter, passive, and detractor breakdown in the qualitative dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Verify NPS segment bars are displayed
Verify segment breakdown details are available

title: Review top categories with stacked bars
description: This verifies that a user can inspect category summaries and compare their stacked bar breakdowns in the qualitative dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Verify top categories are displayed
Verify stacked bar breakdowns are displayed

title: Inspect bar details on hover
description: This verifies that hovering a bar reveals the detailed tooltip needed to interpret qualitative chart values.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Hover over a bar in the sentiment analysis view
Verify a table-format tooltip is displayed

title: Filter comments using the sentiment legend
description: This verifies that clicking a sentiment legend item filters the visible comments to that sentiment.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Click a sentiment legend item
Verify comments for the selected sentiment are displayed

title: Move through comment pages
description: This verifies that a user can page through the qualitative comments list and see additional comments beyond the first page.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Go to the next page of comments
Verify additional comments are displayed

title: Download qualitative analysis export
description: This verifies that a user can trigger the qualitative export and access the downloadable ZIP for offline review when it is available.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Click the export control for qualitative data
Verify an export download is initiated
